meta.name: azure-reliability
meta.description: Assess and improve the reliability posture of PaaS Applications (Azure Functions and Azure App Service). Scans deployed resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a feature-pivoted checklist, then drives staged remediation (CLI or IaC patches) end-to-end with user confirmation. WHEN: "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", "high availability", "disaster recovery", "single points of failure", "reliability posture", "resiliency".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估并修复 Azure 应用的单点故障与灾难恢复短板
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 Azure 应用可能缺少区域冗余或健康探测
copy.tagline_en: Assess and fix single points of failure and disaster recovery gaps in Azure apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your Azure app may lack zone redundancy or health probes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会扫描你在Azure上的Functions和App Service资源，评估可用区冗余、存储冗余、健康探测和多区域故障转移情况，生成按功能分类的可靠性清单，并在你确认后逐步通过命令行或IaC补丁修复问题。
howto.when: 当你说“assess reliability”、“check reliability”等关键词，或要求评估/改进Functions和App Service的可靠性、可用区冗余或多区域故障转移时触发。

say.text: 评估我的Function App的可靠性。
say.note: Claude会扫描并生成可靠性清单。

say.text: 检查我的Web应用是否启用了可用区冗余。
say.note: Claude会检查应用服务计划的区域冗余状态。

say.text: 为我的应用设置多区域故障转移。
say.note: Claude会在确认后生成多区域配置方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scans Azure Functions and App Service resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover, presents a feature-pivoted reliability checklist, and, with user confirmation, drives staged remediation via CLI or IaC patches.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions keywords like "assess reliability" or "check reliability", or asks to evaluate/improve reliability, zone redundancy, or multi-region failover for Azure Functions and App Service.

say_en.text: Assess the reliability of my Function App.
say_en.note: Claude scans and generates a reliability checklist.

say_en.text: Check if my Web app is zone redundant.
say_en.note: Claude checks the app service plan's zone redundancy.

say_en.text: Set up multi-region failover for my app.
say_en.note: Claude asks for confirmation, then sets up the config.
